item.name: Factset Surprise Estimates for Rolling Fiscal Periods

query.description:
(Required) Security or Entity identifiers. FactSet Identifiers, tickers, CUSIP and SEDOL are accepted input.

***ids limit** = 3000 per request*

* Make Note - id limit of 3000 for defaults, otherwise the service is limited to a 30 second duration. This can be reached when increasing total number of metrics requested and depth of history. *

(Required) Requested metrics. Use the /metrics endpoint to return a list of available estimate items. Note, the number of metrics you are allowed to supply is limited to 1 for now. **Top 10** most used metrics are **EPS, SALES, DPS, EBITDA,EBIT, PRICE_TGT, CFPS, BPS, NET_INC, and ASSETS**.  For more details, visit [Online Assistant Page #15034](https://oa.apps.factset.com/pages/15034).
Start date for point in time of estimates expressed in YYYY-MM-DD format.
End date for point in time of estimates expressed in YYYY-MM-DD format.

Controls the frequency of the data returned.
  * **D** = Daily
  * **W** = Weekly, based on the last day of the week of the start date.
  * **AM** = Monthly, based on the start date (e.g., if the start date is June 16, data is displayed for June 16, May 16, April 16 etc.).      
  * **AQ** = Quarterly, based on the start date.
  * **AY** = Actual Annual, based on the start date.

The periodicity for the estimates requested, allowing you to fetch Quarterly, Semi-Annual and Annual Estimates.
  * **ANN** - Annual
  * **QTR** - Quarterly
  * **SEMI** - Semi-Annual
Statistic for consensus calculation.

Currency code for adjusting the data. Use 'ESTIMATE' as input value for the values in Estimate Currency. For a list of currency ISO codes, visit [Online Assistant Page #1470](https://oa.apps.factset.com/pages/1470).
